title: Bulk Droplet Vitrification for Primary Hepatocyte Preservation
protocol: Prepare the vitrification solution 1 (V1) by adding 40 mg of bovine serum albumin to 17.0 mL of University of Wisconsin solution.
Sterile filter the V1 solution using a 0.22 µm filter.
Store the filtered V1 solution at 4 °C.
Combine 7.0 mL of UW, 6.5 mL of DMSO, 6.5 mL of ethylene glycol, 40 mg of BSA, and 5.48 g of sucrose to make vitrification solution 2 (V2).
Sterile filter the V2 solution using a 0.22 µm filter.
Load 3.5 mL of sterile filtered V2 solution into a 3 mL syringe.
Store the loaded syringe at 4 °C.
Prepare the bulk droplet vitrification apparatus.
Cut along one side of the mixing needle’s outer gray sleeve.
Bend the sleeve open and remove it from the mixing needle.
Slide two 25 mm silicone tubing sections over the inlets of the mixing needle.
Secure the position of the silicone tubing with glue.
Cut the needle to a length of 20 mm.
Insert the cutoff outlet of the mixing needle into a 20 G injection needle.
Sterilize the mixing needle assembly by autoclaving.
Fill a sterile Dewar with liquid nitrogen.
Sterilize the outside of the Dewar with isopropanol.
Create a droplet collection device by inserting a funnel with the same outer diameter as the inner diameter of the liquid nitrogen Dewar into a 50 mL conical tube.
Submerge the droplet collection device in liquid nitrogen by slowly pressing it down using large forceps.
Ensure the conical tube rests vertically at the bottom of the Dewar.
Mount a syringe pump in a vertical position on the wall of the cell culture hood.
Place the liquid nitrogen Dewar with the droplet collection device under the vertically mounted syringe pump.
Count the stock concentration of freshly isolated rat hepatocytes by Trypan blue exclusion.
Take 40 million viable hepatocytes.
Centrifuge the hepatocytes at 50 x g for 5 min without brake.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the hepatocytes in 3.4 mL of V1 solution.
Incubate the hepatocytes on ice for 3 min.
Add 150 µL of DMSO and 150 µL of EG to the hepatocytes and mix gently.
Incubate the hepatocytes on ice for another 3 min.
Again, add 150 µL of DMSO and 150 µL of EG to the hepatocytes and mix gently.
Load 3.5 mL in a 3 mL syringe.
Insert the syringe with pre-incubated hepatocytes and the V2 solution syringes onto the syringe pump adapter.
Attach two female Luer lock hose barb adaptors to the syringes.
Slide the silicone tubing of the mixing needle assembly over the barb fittings.
Place the entire assembly in the syringe pump.
Start the pump at 2 mL/min three minutes after the last addition of DMSO and EG to the hepatocytes.
Stop the pump after all hepatocytes have been added to the liquid nitrogen.
Puncture 10 small holes in the lid of a 50 mL conical tube using a 20 G needle.
Wrap the outside of the lid with a flexible film.
Remove the funnel from the liquid nitrogen Dewar.
Use long forceps to take the conical tube containing the droplets out of the liquid nitrogen.
Slowly pour out the excess liquid nitrogen from the conical tube.
Close the conical tube with the punctured lid.
Place the closed conical tube with vitrified hepatocyte droplets back in the liquid nitrogen Dewar.
Transfer the conical tube from the liquid nitrogen into a liquid nitrogen vapor cryotank.
Prepare the rewarming solution by dissolving 17.13 g of sucrose in 100 mL of DMEM hepatocyte culture media.
Sterile filter the rewarming solution using a 0.22 µm filter.
Warm the rewarming solution to 37 °C.
Rewarm the hepatocytes.
Take the conical tube with vitrified hepatocytes from the cryotank.
Transport the conical tube in a liquid nitrogen Dewar to the cell culture hood.
Lightly loosen the cap of the conical tube and return it to the liquid nitrogen.
Add vitrified hepatocyte droplets to an empty beaker.
Instantaneously add warm (37 °C) rewarming solution to the hepatocytes.
Stir the mixture for 10 seconds.
Unload the rewarming solution containing hepatocytes.
Divide the rewarming solution with hepatocytes into two 50 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge the two conical tubes for 2 minutes at 100 x g at 4 °C without brake.
Aspirate the supernatant to leave a total volume of 12.5 mL in each tube using the conical tube’s graduation mark as a reference.
Add 12.5 mL of ice cold DMEM per conical tube to dilute the rewarming solution to 50%.
Resuspend the hepatocytes and incubate on ice for 3 minutes.
Add 25 mL of ice cold DMEM per conical tube to dilute the rewarming solution to 25%.
Centrifuge for 5 minutes at 50 x g at 4 °C without brake.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the hepatocytes in 2 mL of the desired culture medium for use.
